column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 3, 30, 60, 63, 64, 75, 83,
92 and 92 of Block 03, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 710021, situated in the Village of Kudalunuka within the Grama Niladhari
Division of No. 10A - Kudalunuka in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rideemaliyadda, in the District of Badulla, in the Province
of Uva, referred to in Notice No. 71/0065 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1808/23 of
03rd May, 2013 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
